next_frame.docs: Moves the animation to the next frame. This is equivalent to the `id(my_animation).next_frame();` lambda call.

prev_frame.docs: Moves the animation to the previous frame. This is equivalent to the `id(my_animation).prev_frame();` lambda call.

set_frame.docs: Moves the animation to a specific frame. This is equivalent to the `id(my_animation).set_frame(frame);` lambda call.

file.docs:
**string**: The path (relative to where the .yaml file is) of the gif file.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID with which you will be able to reference the animation later in your display code.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

end_frame.docs:
**int**: The last frame to show in the loop; when this frame is reached it will loop back to `start_frame`. Defaults to the last frame in the animation.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

repeat.docs:
**int**: Specifies how many times the loop will run. When the count is reached, the animation will continue with the next frame after `end_frame`, or restart from the beginning if `end_frame` was the last frame. Defaults to "loop forever".

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

start_frame.docs:
**int**: The frame to loop back to when `end_frame` is reached. Defaults to the first frame in the animation.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

loop.docs:
If you want to loop over a subset of your animation (e.g. a fire animation where the fire "starts", then "burns" and "dies") you can specify some frames to loop over.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

resize.docs:
**string**: If set, this will resize all the frames to fit inside the given dimensions `WIDTHxHEIGHT` and preserve the aspect ratio.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

transparency.docs:
If set the alpha channel of the input image will be taken into account. The possible values are `opaque` (default), `chroma_key` and `alpha_channel`. See discussion on transparency in the [image component](https://next.esphome.io/components/image#display-image).

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*

type.docs:
Specifies how to encode image internally. See the [image component](https://next.esphome.io/components/image#display-image) for more information.

*See also: [Animation](https://next.esphome.io/components/animation#configuration-variables)*
